problem: The approved KIDS R8 Access package has a statistical part that is hard to fill and slows every update. Three generators (the R8 script, AccessAuthoringAdapter, and the Control Plane site contract) hold the same facts. The owner requires one package: generic, contract-driven, with authoring classes, generated pick-lists, SDMX component names and a provenance trail that is always present.
scope: A contract-less PROTOTYPE of the target package built from the approved R8 file (ops/scripts/java/prototype), its independent verifier and column audit, a live Microsoft Access acceptance test, a one-page composer design and a proposed canonical standard. No production code path generates this package yet. No publication. The prototype file is evidence, never a source of truth.

Does not add a second registry. impact: Runtime changes made under this card on 2026-09-20: numeric envelope widened to scale 16 (migrations 111 control, 112 data; registry and compiler share one configured envelope), proven lossless on dev. The statistical read endpoint was deployed to dev. Originally: Registry change made earlier in the session (aggregation as part of a measure definition) belongs to AIR-2026-047 and is listed there.
compatibility: The candidate replaces five R8 statistical tables by one SDMX-shaped observation table, a contract catalog and generic W3C-PROV provenance tables. That is legitimate only as a versioned contract revision with mapping, compatibility report and deprecation rule. Until then the required-table findings of the independent audit stand by design. R8, its contract and published snapshot 36 are untouched; rollback is to do nothing.
failure: Builder refuses: a table without a dataset description, a table described twice, a non-constant dataset-level attribute, a non-positive key order, an unknown family. Verifier and live test fail closed and block delivery. Known provider hazards are recorded as facts F-1..F-7 in the canonical standard.
security: No credentials, hosts or secrets in the artefact. DECIDED (ADR-012, 2026-09-20): AGENTS.md forbids executable business logic inside an Access artefact; generated, provenance-only data macros of a closed shape are permitted as integrity automation, and the server never trusts them (standard rule P-6). Any other executable content remains forbidden. Navigation Pane grouping is presentation, not a security boundary.
